name: @banana-universe/example-rest-dual-orm
description: Recipe: TypeORM + Mongoose in one BananaJS app (one ORM per feature module)

scripts.pretest: cd ../../packages/bananajs && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && cd ../ddd && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && cd ../plugin-typeorm && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && cd ../plugin-mongoose && npx tsc -p tsconfig.lib.json && cd ../../apps/example-rest-dual-orm
scripts.test: npm run build && MONGODB_URI=${MONGODB_URI:-mongodb://127.0.0.1:27017/ci_dummy} NODE_ENV=test node --test dist/__tests__/app.test.js
